passes.visualReview: Rough heart-like shape with a higher left lobe, shallow central notch and wide right lobe. Lower body is asymmetric and ends in a rounded blunt point; passes numerically but has substantial room for visual improvement.

Clear two-lobe heart-like silhouette with a visible dip between lobes. Left lobe is higher; right lobe bulges outward and the lower point is blunt and off-centre. Higher numerical overlap than the reference does not mean better symmetry.
Heart-like silhouette with two unequal upper lobes, visible shallow notch and tapered lower body. The point remains blunt, and the left shoulder/right bulge make it noticeably asymmetric.

Weak, asymmetric heart-like silhouette: high rounded left lobe, broad lower right lobe, shallow dip between them and a blunt tapered tip. The high score overstates the visual polish; it is not a clean symmetric heart.

Marginal visual match despite its 89.3% score. Rounded asymmetric body, high left lobe and barely visible shallow dip; right lobe dominates and the base is broad/blunt. Weakly heart-like, with a less convincing notch than the reviewed reference. The one-cell check is not sufficient for visual quality.

Asymmetric heart-like shape: raised left lobe, broad right lobe, a shallow central dip and a narrowing but blunt lower tip. Clearer taper than attempt 8, though still a weak visual match to a symmetric heart.
Recognisable asymmetric heart: two rounded lobes and a shallow central notch, with a tapered lower body and blunt tip. The right side dominates; it is not a clean symmetric heart.

Rough asymmetric heart: two upper lobes with a very shallow central dip, broad right side and elongated blunt lower point. The notch is visibly weaker than the target; not an oval, but not clean latte art.
Recognisable heart-like silhouette: both lobes and the shallow central notch are visible. Right half is fuller and the left edge has a shoulder; the lower tip is still rounded. Not an oval.

Small heart-like shape with two rounded lobes, a shallow notch, and a narrowing blunt tip. Right side is fuller and left edge has a shoulder; less target coverage than the stronger passes, but visibly not an oval.
Two-lobe heart-like silhouette with a shallow dip, taller left lobe, broad right side and blunt lower point. High overlap but pronounced asymmetry; not a clean heart.

Recognisable rough heart: two rounded upper lobes with a small central notch and a taper toward the lower point. Right side is fuller and the point remains blunt. Better visual separation of the lobes than the marginal seed-42 attempt-8 pass.
